title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 033 ]

blocks.text: Nothing can take the place of reading-no lecture or image on a screen has the same power to enlighten. Pictures are a most valuable means of illustrating a written text, but they hardly enable us to form general ideas. Films, like the spoken word, flow by and are lost to us. Books abide, as life-long companions.

readingSentences.english: Nothing can take the place of reading-no lecture or image on a screen has the same power to enlighten.
readingSentences.korean: 아무것도 독서를 대신할 수 없다 - 어떤 강의 나 영화의 영상도 계몽할 수 있는 동일한 힘을 가지지 못한다.
